title: Signal Plugin Capability Browser

launch.notes: The default task now launches the interactive browser in system scan mode with bounded exact-root scan batches, local-first macOS inventory, and auto-selected localhost serving when the default port is occupied. The browser surfaces local/server availability at a glance and keeps the bounded non-interactive validation entrypoint available as `effigy demo:plugin-capability-browser:proof`.

scenarios.title: Installed Plugin Inventory With Bounded Host Launch
scenarios.summary: Browses real discovered plugin inventory and proves one bounded supported host interaction path without embedding a heavyweight UI framework.

evidence.notes: The surface remains intentionally bounded: inventory plus one host-owned interaction proof, not custom plugin-editor embedding or a persistent plugin workstation.

known_exclusions: The browser does not embed vendor plugin editors or build a heavyweight shared UI runtime.
The launch surface proves one bounded host-owned parameter-step interaction, not arbitrary continuous transport control.
LV2 remains server-host only, and local host launch remains macOS-only.
Local launch buttons are only shown for plugins returned by the local scan surface; the browser does not infer local launchability from server discovery alone.
The official proof task defaults to one bounded fixture-backed scan so the browser stays automatable even if arbitrary installed plugins hang during discovery.
The operator surface now summarizes availability and launch outcome before the raw bounded host detail, but it remains a bounded proof surface rather than a persistent plugin session shell.
Interactive system scans now prefer bounded local inventory first on macOS and use bounded exact-root scan batches rather than claiming exhaustive machine-wide crawl posture.
expected_checks: The browser shows real discovered plugin inventory rather than a hardcoded catalog.
The browser exposes per-plugin bounded launch targets through repo-owned commands.
The browser surfaces local versus server availability clearly enough that an operator does not need to inspect raw launch-target JSON first.
At least one supported CLAP or VST3 path launches successfully during official capture.
At least one launch surfaces explicit bounded interaction truth beyond bootstrap success alone.
Interactive system-mode runs survive killed or slow host scans as bounded degradation instead of crashing or blanking the browser wholesale.
Platform and unsupported-path exclusions remain explicit in the surface.
